data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2017 were GBP 512.293m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 8.718m (1.70% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse/expected future claim development principally in liability exposures. The report states that the liability sections of the Specialty Programmes and Package Programmes were further strengthened in recognition of incurred and potential future claim development, although this was offset by favourable experience in much of the remainder of the portfolio. The 2017 calendar year was also impacted by Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, earthquakes in Mexico and wildfires in California.
